name: agent-terminal
title: Agent Terminal
description: An unbranded coding-agent terminal: the window or launcher eases in, panels fade up and a task types itself into the prompt with a blinking caret.
useWhen: Showing a coding agent or command-line assistant taking a task, without naming any product.
A task should type itself into a terminal prompt with welcome context around it.
A developer-tool video needs a terminal card in your own accent colour.
avoidWhen: You need the agent to run, stream steps and show results: use agent-run.
You need a plain shell with scrolling output: use terminal-simulator.
You only need a typed line with a caret: use caret or a typewriter text block.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Layout
variables.description: A framed terminal window with a welcome panel, or a centered launcher with a prompt box.

variables.label: App name
variables.description: Generic name shown as the panel title (with a version) or the launcher wordmark.

variables.label: User name
variables.description: Name in the panel greeting (panel layout).

variables.label: Model label
variables.description: Muted line under the glyph (panel layout).

variables.label: Working directory
variables.description: Muted path under the model label (panel layout).

variables.label: Tips
variables.description: Pipe-separated lines in the right-hand panel (panel layout).
variables.default: /plan to outline a task|/review to check a change|ctrl+b to run in the background

variables.label: Placeholder
variables.description: Muted hint shown in the empty prompt.

variables.label: Prompt
variables.description: Task that types itself into the prompt.
variables.default: edit src/theme.ts to add a dark mode toggle

variables.label: Agent mode
variables.description: Highlighted mode label under the launcher prompt (launcher layout).

variables.label: Model name
variables.description: Model shown under the launcher prompt (launcher layout).

variables.label: Provider
variables.description: Muted provider name next to the model (launcher layout).

variables.label: Accent
variables.description: Colour of the frame, title and mode label.

variables.label: Transparent
variables.description: Leave the background clear so the terminal sits over your own scene.

variables.label: Speed
variables.description: Playback speed multiplier; above 1 the scene plays faster and holds the end.
